tools.name: search_uk_legislation
tools.description: Search UK legislation provisions (employment, equality, consumer, data protection, company, health & safety law) by keyword. Returns provisions with their amendment history.

tools.name: get_provision_history
tools.description: Get the full point-in-time amendment history for one provision: every version boundary date and what changed at each.

tools.name: get_recent_amendments
tools.description: List the most recent amendments across all tracked UK provisions. Useful for answering 'what changed in UK employment law recently?'

tools.name: get_most_amended
tools.description: List the provisions that have changed most often — the least stable areas of UK law.
